issue_container.title: Improve conditional RF link prediction beyond the strongest direct calibration baseline
issue_container.body:
Improve prediction of excluded reference-link RF increments in Satellite's native calibration code. On the current stable differential inputs, the clock-only, wet-only and complete source models have been replayed on the same fixed last-third link holdouts. Adding freely fitted source shapes severely worsens phase prediction. Existing free-drift and a bounded training-GCV predictive shrinkage comparison have also been executed; neither beats the strongest simple primary baseline. The request is to improve predictive transfer beyond that strongest direct comparison, not merely rescue the worst full model.

Use only admitted non-candidate reference data. The fixed held link/epoch measurements, including their GF/MW/phase/code values and continuity witnesses, must be removed before fitting, choosing parameters or selecting boundaries. Other reference links at the excluded epochs remain available. Geometry and masks are conditional on the existing nominal preparation. This is conditional missing-link prediction, not RF-free forecasting of the entire clock network.

A useful contribution can be a transferable mechanism from another domain, not necessarily an installable library. Decide whether external code is worth investigating, choose the operations, search phrases and one source yourself. Do not choose from donor names supplied by an operator; none is supplied. A defensible use_direct, defer or no-source decision is valid. You may adapt a predictive strategy, but do not assert its empirical assumptions are a qualified physical source prior or covariance.

Success is at least 10% lower pooled 300-second phase RMS than the strongest direct primary baseline, on the original common 874 increment pairs; retain all 1248 common 30-second pairs. On each lag, pooled code RMS and 30-second phase RMS may be at most 2% above the best direct value for that metric. At least four of the five folds must improve 300-second phase RMS versus the same globally chosen primary baseline; no fold may worsen it by over 10%. Preserve and report all missing/unknown predictions and every worsening. These are operator-set practical pilot criteria fixed before donor search, not physical qualification thresholds or statistical significance.

Fit or choose all parameters from training only. Keep historical inputs, masks, raw marginal weights, rank/identifiability definitions and results unchanged. Never complete an unidentifiable physical source or raw common clock with an arbitrary zero. Source amplitudes, physical covariance, G12 state and candidate CODE orbit must not be used as labels, priors, tuning targets or acceptance truth. No orbital-state refit is part of this trial. A native predictive improvement is the sole potential gain; physical source attribution and S2 remain unproven. A donor-only sandbox example is insufficient.

Allow one bounded adaptation of the selected external mechanism and one parameter-selection rule decided without held scores, with no donor replacement, rescue queries, paid retries, or holdout-driven tuning. Compare every result on the unchanged support and all five folds. Source inspection does not establish benefit; only native execution can do that. If a modification is justified, it requires native regressions and Windows/Linux CI before integration.
